timeline.entryText: The Wally71551 YouTube channel is created. Initially, the channel was a Minecraft Let's Play-themed YouTube channel under a different name.
Gusty Garden Galaxy 8-Bit Orchestra - Super Mario Galaxy was uploaded. This is the initial upload that has since been unlisted, replaced by a reupload on 26th November 2017.
Prince Sidon's Theme Remix - The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild is uploaded. This is the initial upload that has since been unlisted, replaced by a reupload on 10th July 2017.
Ultimate Koopa Remix - Super Mario 64 is uploaded. This is the initial upload that has since been unlisted, replaced by a reupload on 11th July 2017.
Vista Point Remix - Gothic 3 is uploaded. This is the initial upload that has since been unlisted, replaced by a reupload on 12th July 2017.
Nox Aeterna Remix - Final Fantasy XV is uploaded. This is the initial upload that has since been unlisted, replaced by a reupload on 13th July 2017.
Nox Aeterna 8-Bit - Final Fantasy XV is uploaded. This is the initial upload that has since been unlisted, replaced by a reupload on 13th July 2017.
Tenebrae Remix - Final Fantasy XV is uploaded. This is the initial upload that has since been unlisted, replaced by a reupload on 14th July 2017.
Prince Sidon's Theme - The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild Remix is uploaded. This is the reuploaded version, replacing the unlisted version from 25th April 2017.
Ultimate Koopa - Super Mario 64 Remix is uploaded. This is the reuploaded version, replacing the unlisted version from 30th April 2017.
Vista Point - Gothic 3 Remix is uploaded. This is the reuploaded version, replacing the unlisted version from 7th May 2017.
Nox Aeterna 8-Bit - Final Fantasy XV Remix is uploaded. This is the reuploaded version, replacing the unlisted version from 14th May 2017.
Nox Aeterna - Final Fantasy XV Remix is uploaded. This is the reuploaded version, replacing the unlisted version from 14th May 2017.
Tenebrae - Final Fantasy XV Remix is uploaded. This is the reuploaded version, replacing the unlisted version from 21th May 2017.
Rito Village (Night) - The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild Remix is uploaded.
Inkoming - Splatoon 2 Remix is uploaded.
The very initial version of the Wally71551 Music website is created.
The last update to the initial version of the Wally71551 Music website is pushed.
The idea for the redevelopment for the Wally71551 YouTube channel begins to slowly make development.
Slow work begins on the Wally71551 website.
